payload.name: Extract Explicit Stated Preferences
payload.description: Use during extraction when a speaker explicitly names a favorite or preferred item (e.g., show, book, food, activity) in a message that also mentions shared interests or relationships.
content: During extraction, when a speaker explicitly states a favorite or preferred item (e.g., "X is my favorite show"), create a profile or preference memory for that speaker containing the named item, even if the message also supports a broader relationship or shared-interest memory.
Do not let a generic relationship enrichment candidate absorb the specific preference; keep the explicit preference as its own candidate with the speaker as subject.
Create at most one candidate per explicitly named preference, and stop after the stated favorites are captured; do not infer additional favorites or expand to other topics.

solves: Extraction produces only a generic relationship or shared-interest memory and drops a speaker's explicitly stated favorite or preferred item, so later questions about that person's preferences cannot be answered. This skill ensures explicit preference statements are captured as standalone memories.
